positive.text: The rule was published at 65 FR 287 (Jan. 4, 2000).
The agency proposed the rule at 86 FR 12345.

note: url_templates: govinfo link service, verified by HTTP fetch on 2026-10-23: https://www.govinfo.gov/link/fr/85/12345 redirects to the FR-2020-03-02 PDF at that page (also 88/1000 and 60/5000); a comma page answers 400, so the template and the key use {page|digits} (`12,345` and `12345` are one authority). federalregister.gov sends scripts to a bot check: decoder only. `FR` is the Federal Register's own short abbreviation; Indigo uses it in T2 examples. Same authority key as us.fed.federal_register. Merged with us.fed.federal_register.fr_abbreviated (retired): page ranges (`85 FR 7037-38`) and the Document Drafting Handbook examples.
